context: User-observed ChatGPT execution interruptions during Powerhouse work, including network loss, interrupted streaming, failed reasoning and unexpected stop of reasoning, followed by production verification of durable recovery runtime.
failed_pattern: Treating a chat/model/stream lifetime, a merged PR, or function existence alone as proof that the underlying durable recovery process is live.
fix: Move task continuity to canonical durable Powerhouse state with checkpoints, obligations, heartbeat/watchdog detection, side-effect readback, idempotency/dedupe guards, bounded retries, explicit recovery state, source-controlled scheduler wiring and production readback.
prevention: Every material chat and agent must ingest powerhouse-execution-resilience-v1 via the existing chat-learning preflight; an interrupted non-terminal run becomes RECOVERY_REQUIRED and may resume only after canonical state and side-effect reconciliation. A merged migration is never production evidence; functions, grants, scheduler and natural runtime must be read back independently.
resume_contract: read the current operation version immediately before compare-and-set mutation

evidence.local_regression_run: 6/6 PASS after expanding interruption classifier to recognize Dutch network wording
evidence.important_test_learning: The first regression run failed because the classifier only recognized English network terms. The test correctly exposed a localization gap; network/netwerk/verbinding matching was then added and the suite passed.
evidence.ci_coverage_learning: Shared Agent Memory CI correctly failed when the resilience test was not selected. The canonical regression path is tests/brain-execution-resilience-guard.test.mjs under the existing guard family; documentation was corrected to that exact path.
evidence.deployment_drift_learning: PR 1887 was merged, but production initially did not contain the three resilience functions. Merge state and production state are separate truths and require explicit readback.
evidence.runtime_wiring_learning: After the functions were deployed, no scheduler invoked the watchdog. A source-controlled pg_cron migration now schedules powerhouse-execution-resilience-watchdog-v1 every minute.
evidence.production_selftest_result: Checkpoint heartbeat was durably stored; simulated stale detection moved the operation to RESULT_UNKNOWN/RECOVERY_REQUIRED and created a canonical PENDING EXECUTION_RESILIENCE_RECOVERY reconciliation job with readback_before_replay=true.
evidence.cas_learning: A heartbeat attempt using an assumed literal version returned STATE_VERSION_CONFLICT while a subsequent call using the version read directly from brain_operations succeeded. Root cause of the first mismatch was not proven; prevention is to read the current version immediately before CAS mutation and treat conflicts as drift/concurrency evidence rather than blindly retrying.
evidence.safety_boundary: The generic watchdog enqueues recovery but does not replay domain side effects. Domain-specific recovery must read back outcome/side effects and satisfy idempotency or dedupe proof before mutation.
